summary: In compact mode a GitHub poller no longer writes a `vcs.item.state` identical to the item's newest one. The two states were compared in key order, and a stored state reads back in another order than a new one is built in, so every look that reached an item wrote a fresh state, whether or not it changed. They now compare as maps. An unchanged state is pinned as it is, except when the look delivers the item to a plain message subscription: a message's key names the item claims it carries, so such a delivery still gets a fresh state of its own, one per delivered change. Fixes #4553.

replay.detail: No claim or projection replay; duplicate states already written stay.

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Only how often the poller writes an existing claim kind changes; no claim kind, field or wire capability changes, and members of older builds read the same claims.

recovery.detail: Rolling back restores the duplicate states; nothing reads them differently.
